title: Pushing Doors
description: A vanilla-friendly physics mod that lets you seamlessly push and breach doors open with your body instead of right-clicking
body:
**You need to install geckolib**

**You need to install Player Animator [1.1]**

# 🚪 Pushing Doors

Tired of constantly right-clicking every time you want to go through a door? **Pushing Doors** completely overhauls how you interact with doors in Minecraft.

Trapdoors got overhauled too [1.1]

This mod does **not** overwrite vanilla doors. [in 1.1 is automatically converted]

~~**_In the next update, all vanilla Minecraft doors will automatically convert into pushing doors_**~~

---

## Core Features
Seamless Walk-Through (Physics-Based)

- Simply walk into any dynamic door, and your body will naturally push it open.

Lock

- You can lock the door by using lever (or as long it was redstone)

Barge In

- Sprint directly into a locked door to breach it open, This action deactivate any nearby levers or redstone power sources that were holding the lock. For trapdoor you need to hold sprint then jump to barge or stomp

Peek

- Hold right click at the door to peek, and move mouse up or down to move the player. [1.2] You can hold shift to peep at the keyhole in this state

---

## 🛠️ Crafting

simply place any standard vanilla door into a crafting grid

[in 1.1 you can just simply put down any vanilla wood door to the ground to convert, or just craft the door and its converted already]

*Supports all 11 vanilla wood variants (Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Bamboo, Crimson, and Warped).*
